faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.ctaText: See in a demo how to turn a search request into a focused Belgian company selection.
faq.q1: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a1: After registration, use the email code and your licence to activate your web account. You can then work in the browser and download the Windows desktop app from Account.
faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
faq.a2: BelgoBase uses available KBO company data and financial information from NBB sources. Source years and available fields can differ by company.
faq.a3: BelgoBase is intended for professional B2B users. Read the privacy statement and use data only for a lawful purpose.
faq.q4: Can I choose my own criteria?
faq.a4: Yes. Combine criteria such as NACE, Flanders, Wallonia or Brussels, legal form, FTE and available financial fields.
faq.a5: Yes. You will receive an official invoice. The package price currently shown is €2,500 excl. VAT.
faq.q6: How does AI- and voice-assisted Smart Search work?
faq.a6: Type or dictate your request. BelgoBase suggests filters; you review and apply them yourself. This feature uses the AI balance configured for your licence.
faq.a7: You can export a selection to Excel and choose which available company and financial columns to include.
faq.q8: Do you cover all of Belgium?
faq.a8: Yes. You can search in Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels. Available company and financial data can differ by company.
faq.q9: Does BelgoBase work in the browser and on Windows?
faq.a9: Yes. Your web account gives you browser access. The desktop app is Windows-only and is available from Account after sign-in.
